szoveg_eredeti:
HONG KONG SAR – Media OutReach Newswire – 4 November 2026 – The "Global University Presidents and Leaders Summit 2026", organized by the Hong Kong Association for External Friendship (HKAEF), has successfully concluded. This year's summit achieved fruitful outcomes. Beyond establishing an exchange platform that gathered presidents and senior management from over 50 universities across more than 20 countries and regions to interact and explore collaboration opportunities with local tertiary institutions, participating university presidents reached a vital consensus on the mission of university education in the current era of Artificial Intelligence (AI) before the event concluded. They have released a joint declaration that underscores the importance of liberal arts education to human social development alongside the promotion of AI education.

The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement.

By Hong Kong Association for External Friendship
